name: Commuter Compass
summary: Town window card: towns your commuters travel to and from, how far, and how many ride your lines.
description: Adds a Commuters card to the town window. Outbound lists the towns where this town's residents work or shop; Inbound lists the towns whose residents work or shop here. Each sortable table shows the straight-line distance, work and shop trips, and how many of those trips use your lines. A third list shows the three nearest towns with no commuters either way. Every row can show one arrow on the map. A sibling of Cargo Compass. Cosmetic: achievements stay enabled.
